items.label: Package contain
items.value: 6 sets grow through plant supports and 66ft garden twist tie,each support consists of one grid top and three legs,providing ample support for multi-plants.

items.label: Sturdy material
items.value: Those peony cages supports are made of sturdy iron wire with green powder coating,featured strong,reusable,and durable for years to use,not affected by weather,making it stands firmly even in sunlight and rain

items.label: Size information
items.value: About 12 inches in diameter and 16 inches in height for each peony support,ideal for most bushy plants tomato plants and vine plants.The green surface of the bracket blends seamlessly with the supporting green plants, making it natural without appearing strange

items.label: Easy to use
items.value: The plant grid peony cages supports are very easy to assemble,just space three legs around the outside ring of each grid top,push 3 legs about 4" to 6" into the ground,detachable design make it easy to installs and removes without taking up too much space

items: Wide application - The rounded shape plant supports features well support and protect plants,install grow through supports early in the growing season make it easier for plants to grow taller and straighter.Perfect for peonies, tomatoes,begonias,cosmos,etc.
